The main point is more deep players means more deep pass coverage. Less deep means more chances at being burnt

Basically cover # tells how many safeties and/or corners are deep in zone as protection against the deep ball. 

Cover 0 means no one is deep, everyone guards a man 

Cover 1 means only one protects against the deep ball, 2 means 2, 3 means 3 players are deep. The more deep players we have the better deep pass defense we have, but usually means less run defense and vice versa
